item.title: SAGALang — Interpreted Programming Language
item.description:
Overview

Created an interpreted imperative programming language with a complete implementation stack from lexer to interpreter. The language follows a traditional interpreter pipeline with tokenization, parsing into an AST, and tree-walking interpretation, enhanced with modern ML-based developer tooling.

GitHub Repository

This project extends beyond concepts from Crafting Interpreters by Robert Nystrom

Key Features

  • Language Implementation: Built a custom lexer, parser, and interpreter entirely in Python
  • Standard Library: Developed a standard library supporting real-time graphics capabilities
  • AI-Powered Completion: Integrated neural code completion using transformer models for intelligent suggestions

Technologies

Python Transformers Language Design Lexical Analysis Parsing

item.title: Implementation of PointLLM
item.description:
Overview

Implemented PointLLM based on the paper arXiv:2308.16911, integrating point cloud encoders with pretrained large language models for 3D understanding tasks.

Key Contributions

  • Multimodal Integration: Combined a point cloud encoder with a pretrained LLM for unified 3D-language understanding

  • 3D Captioning: Enabled automatic generation of natural language descriptions for 3D point cloud data

  • Classification: Achieved competitive performance on 3D object classification benchmarks

Technologies

PyTorch Transformers Point Cloud Processing LLM 3D Vision

item.title: Clairvoyance — Smart Glasses for Visual Assistance
item.description:
Overview

Built a multimodal AI system designed to assist visually impaired users by combining object recognition, depth estimation, and OCR capabilities.

Key Contributions

  • Synthetic Dataset: Generated a comprehensive dataset of scene–query pairs covering diverse real-world scenarios and edge cases
  • Intent Classification: Trained an embedding-based intent classifier to map user inquiries to appropriate visual or generative tasks
  • Response Generation: Fine-tuned a BART model for context-aware verbal response generation
  • Fallback Mechanism: Integrated an LLM-powered agent to dynamically handle out-of-scope or unplanned tasks

Technologies

PyTorch HuggingFace Transformers BART Computer Vision OCR Depth Estimation
